summary: The landscape centers on two recent reranking directions for RAG. LLM-Confidence Reranker (LCR) is a training-free reranker that derives an LLM confidence signal via MSCP, using multinomial sampling and clustering to prioritize documents while preserving rankings for high-confidence queries. It is evaluated on BEIR and TREC with BM25 and Contriever, and reports gains in NDCG@5 versus pretrained LLM rerankers and fine-tuned transformer rerankers. RRPO is a reinforcement-learning approach that uses LLM feedback to optimize rerankers, evaluated on AmbigNQ and HotpotQA with EM and F1, and compared against several off-the-shelf rerankers plus RAG baselines such as FLARE and DRAGIN.
